notes: μέν is unrepresented: the correlation is carried by the articles' some … some and by δέ, and marking it elsewhere is not writing it (rule 70). A reference comparison will report this as a disagreement, and that report is not a correction.
τοῖς λεγομένοις splits under rule 22's supplied-nominal clause — the article takes the things, headed on the nominal, and the participle keeps which were spoken.
